propositions: reconcile-bridge.yml never sets merge.ours.driver, so the merge=ours attribute names an undefined driver on the runner.
With the driver undefined, git falls back to a 3-way text merge of the large .bridge_state JSON file instead of local-wins behaviour.
reconcile-bridge.yml must set merge.ours.driver=true for the tickets worktree before any merge step.
The canary workflow already obtains the driver via its existing rebar init call and must remain untouched, guarded against regression.
A reconverge against a diverged remote in a runner-shaped checkout should resolve .bridge_state/* local-wins with no conflict markers.
This fix is a prerequisite for the CI blob:none clone filter, which removes merge-base blobs the reconverge path materializes.
